what: Server-authoritative prop physics and consented spectator vitals against a local SpacetimeDB 2.13 standalone server (127.0.0.1:3000, database hush-local). Not Maincloud.
sensing: SIMULATED development fixture (browser build has no native Presage). Labelled SIMULATED on the spectator page.

results.check: first trace batch creates a resting 12-prop world visible to the spectator
SCARE impact wakes props and the server tick advances them
props settle back to sleep within 4 s, displaced by the pound
the scheduled tick stops once every prop sleeps
a resent event batch does not re-apply its impulse
no vitals row exists before the player opts in
opted-in vitals reach the spectator, labelled simulated, without a server clock
an accepted reading without a pulse is rejected
a wrong owner capability cannot write vitals
a later reading replaces the row (latest value only)
withdrawing consent deletes the row for the spectator
an owner knock moves exactly that prop
a spectator with the wrong capability receives no rows at all
removing the session removes trace and props from the spectator

browser.player: http://127.0.0.1:5181 (npm run dev with VITE_SPACETIMEDB_HOST=ws://127.0.0.1:3000, VITE_SPACETIMEDB_DB_NAME=hush-local); trace sharing and the separate heart-rate consent turned on in the J panel; status read 'SpacetimeDB live trace'.
browser.spectator: http://localhost:5181/#watch=... (different origin, so no BroadcastChannel; data came only through SpacetimeDB). Page read 'Live · SpacetimeDB', SIMULATED 72 BPM, 0 vs baseline, Holding steady, Stage 1 of 4, creature 16-17 of 24, exposure 13-14%, 'PROPS · SPACETIMEDB PHYSICS' with all 12 props drawn.
browser.staleness: With the player tab hidden (game pauses), the spectator showed 'no update for 13 s' and dimmed the reading as held.
browser.notChecked: A door pound seen in the browser (covered by the server end-to-end run instead); Electron desktop with live Presage; Maincloud.
